emotionalLog.title: Emotional log

hero.title: Your emotional state deserves follow-up too
hero.text: This space helps you recognize mood, anxiety, and stress patterns. You can record how you feel at different moments of the day.

info.title: How does the emotional log work?
info.text: Record your emotional state whenever you need to. Each entry is ordered by date and time so you and your specialist can review your progress.
info.step1: You can record more than one emotion during the day.
info.step2: The history shows each moment by time.
info.step3: Your specialist can use this information to support you better.
